english.title: Cause / permit failure to retain CCTV images in relation to slaughterhouses
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

**(..SPECIFY NAME..), the business operator of a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..), to fail to make arrangements for the retention and storage of images and information obtained by a CCTV system, installed to provide a complete and clear image of killing and related operations in all areas of the slaughterhouse where live animals were present, for 90 days beginning with the date the images or information were obtained and that those arrangements were appropriate to maintain the integrity and quality of the images and information retained
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4, 9(1)(b) and 12 of the Mandatory Use of Closed Circuit Television in Slaughterhouses (England) Regulations 2018.
